correctness.rationale: Fixed s with gcd(n,s)=g yields g shift cycles of length h=n/g; exactly one cycle has two transitions, giving n(q−1)(h−1)q^g/2 words. Gabrić Lemma 14 controls two noninverse distance-two shifts; this partitions shift sets into full subgroup gZ_n\{0} or an exceptional inverse pair. For h>=3 every subgroup word has unique g-periodic background at Hamming distance one; for h=2 it is a pair of halves differing in one coordinate. Therefore N_g has the stated 2 cases, Möbius inversion yields E_g, first moment T counts all shifts and B catches the remaining inverse pairs. Independent brute-force complete q=3,n=2..7 and q=4,n=2..5 agreed for every r, including q=3 n=6 (441,126,126,36). General classification depends on the primary proved structural lemma, not finite tests.
